worstluck.config.title: Worst Luck Possible Settings
worstluck.config.read_only.tooltip: The server owns these settings. Operator permission is required to change them.
worstluck.config.storm_frequency.maximum: Caps clear rain and thunder timers at ten minutes, making thunderstorms return frequently.
worstluck.config.storm_frequency.vanilla: Leaves Minecraft's normal weather timers unchanged.
worstluck.config.lightning_targets.loade: Each successful attempt strikes a vanilla surface position in the ticking chunk.
worstluck.config.lightning_targets.playe: Strikes a rain-exposed player first, otherwise a passive mob. No valid target means no lightning.

Targets rain-exposed players, then passive mobs, then sampled burnable full blocks with a solid upper face. Thin or multipart blocks such as doors, trapdoors, signs, and beds are excluded. No valid target means no lightning.
worstluck.config.lightning_targets.vanil: Uses Minecraft's original lightning frequency, targeting, and skeleton-horse trap logic.
worstluck.config.lightning_frequency.too: Chance for each mod-controlled lightning opportunity to proceed. Range: 1–100%. This does not affect Vanilla targeting mode.
worstluck.config.fishing.vanilla.tooltip: The mod does not change bite waiting time or fishing loot.
worstluck.config.fishing.bad.tooltip: Uses the maximum initial bite wait and replaces every successful catch with fully damaged leather boots.
worstluck.config.fishing.long_vanilla.to: Uses the maximum initial bite wait but keeps the normal vanilla fishing loot table.
worstluck.config.fire.vanilla.tooltip: Restores vanilla fire spread, fuel consumption, lifetime, and lava ignition.
worstluck.config.fire.eternal.tooltip: Keeps fueled fire at age 0, preserves nearby fuel until extinguished, and performs accelerated fire and lava ignition.
worstluck.config.fire.accelerated.toolti: Adds up to eight vanilla-valid fire and lava ignitions per source opportunity, but retains vanilla fire aging and fuel consumption.
worstluck.config.responsible.tooltip: New worlds copy this setting. When enabled, their settings can only be changed with operator permission.
worstluck.config.responsible.confirm.ena: This will lock the settings of newly created worlds unless the player has operator permission.
worstluck.config.responsible.confirm.dis: Disabling the lock for this world requires operator permission and allows its owner to edit settings normally.
worstluck.config.profile.maximum.tooltip: Applies the mod-controlled worst outcome to every configurable gameplay mechanic. Responsible mode is not changed.
worstluck.config.profile.vanilla.tooltip: Disables every configurable gameplay intervention. Responsible mode is not changed.
worstluck.config.profile.custom.tooltip: Shown automatically when the settings do not match either complete preset. Selecting it does not change individual options.
worstluck.config.player_projectiles.vani: Leaves the random uncertainty of projectiles fired by players unchanged.
worstluck.config.player_projectiles.wors: Moves player projectile spread to a varied edge of the vanilla per-axis uncertainty cube without changing speed.
worstluck.config.hostile_projectiles.van: Keeps the hostile shooter’s ordinary random projectile spread.
worstluck.config.hostile_projectiles.lea: Uses only the available vanilla spread allowance to aim toward a moving player’s predicted position; otherwise chooses the closest allowed direction.
worstluck.config.projectile_critical.van: Keeps the vanilla random critical-damage bonus for persistent projectiles.
worstluck.config.projectile_critical.wor: Gives player projectiles the minimum bonus and hostile projectiles the maximum vanilla-random bonus.
worstluck.config.explosions.vanilla.tool: Keeps vanilla explosion-ray strength, fire rolls, and explosion-dependent block-drop rolls.
worstluck.config.explosions.maximum.tool: Maximizes random ray strength, guarantees valid fire rolls for fiery explosions, and fails explosion-dependent block drops whenever vanilla allows failure.
worstluck.config.mob_looting.tooltip: Fixed effective Looting level for enchanted-count mob loot functions, independent of the attacker’s weapon. The screen offers Off and I–III. Config files accept any nonnegative integer; values above 3 remain unchanged until this slider is moved.
Keeps ordinary runtime spawning of land animals, fish, axolotls, and other passive water creatures.
worstluck.config.passive_spawns.disabled: Removes passive groups from ordinary runtime spawn cycles. Seed-dependent chunk-generation animals are unchanged.
worstluck.config.hostile_distance.vanill: Keeps Minecraft’s normal hostile spawning distance and vertical checks.
Prefers valid hostile spawns 24–32 blocks from the nearest player, with a vanilla-range seed spawn allowed when that player has no hostiles.
worstluck.config.hostile_packs.vanilla.t: Keeps vanilla pack-size rolls, wave count, preliminary attempts, and coordinate jitter.
worstluck.config.hostile_packs.maximum.t: Chooses the maximum pack-size roll, doubles waves and preliminary attempts, and tightens coordinate jitter.
At the hostile cap, permits a valid close spawn only when a safe distant hostile can be removed afterward. Also protects the 32–128 block reservoir when nearby pressure is low.
worstluck.config.distant_replacement.off: Restores vanilla mob-cap denial and vanilla distance-based despawning.
worstluck.config.phantoms.vanilla.toolti: Uses Minecraft’s normal phantom cooldown, chance, and group-size calculation.
worstluck.config.phantoms.four.tooltip: After three sleepless days, every eligible player receives four phantoms at a guaranteed 1200–1400 tick interval while vanilla darkness and spawn-space checks still pass.
